source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The mixin receives selectors in its constructor, subscribes immediately and leaves initial application to the subclass after setup. It compares each selected result with the cached result using strict equality; it does not notify on every dispatch or deeply watch a retained object. dispose releases the subscription. The inspected selectValue method computes the selector directly because !args does not detect an empty rest array. The test checks initial/later values but does not assert behavior after disposal.
title: storeObserver needs explicit initial application and disposal, and compares selected results
